description: The same two machines where the replay target is `@sig` — the reactive governed by the log's OWN machine. Isolates the cross-machine condition from replay itself.
rationale: §51.14.6 — when the log IS some machine M's `audit` target, its entries carry M's variant names. Replaying them into a reactive governed by a DIFFERENT machine would commit variant names that need not exist in the target's enum, producing nonsensical state through a path that bypasses the ordinary write guard. A hand-built (non-audit) log is deliberately left alone — the check fires only when the log's owning machine is known.
